description: I'm Arkar, excited to put my python programming to good use and learn something new by making a sweet little app !
summary: Launching a voyage to Mars, our astronauts are guided with a health monitoring system, monitoring levels such as their stress, cortisol, and radiation dosage rates with a dosimeter. We will carry out countermeasures like entering solar shelters to shield ourselves from the hazards in space.
details: we used html and javascript to measure stress cortisol and radiation
